summary: Full end-to-end regression sweep of Careers/HR system after Payroll + OrgChart + Employee Self-Service additions. Backend: 91 pytests pass, 5 skipped (env-dependent), 0 failures across the entire careers suite (test_careers_investors, phase_a, phase_bc, phase_d, phase_fg, phase_h, phase3_extended, candidate_portal, referral_share, employee_portal_payroll). This covers: public jobs CRUD, apply-with-resume + duplicate rejection, investor endpoints (metrics/faq/team/press/docs/contact), 30-status pipeline, tests+interviews+notes+offers, employee master + onboarding + 5 letter kinds, attendance + leaves (with auto-marking on approval), performance/incentives, RBAC + notification templates + audit, separation + HR analytics, candidate portal hydration + referral share, employee JWT flow (set-password, login, /me, change-password, 5-fail lockout HTTP 423), payroll config + salary structure + run + idempotency 400 + payslip PDF + NEFT/PF/ESI/PT/TDS CSVs + cancel-run cleanup, org chart tree + cycle + self-loop detection, and cross-module integrity (leave->attendance, experience letter->separated, applicant->joined status). Frontend: /careers loads with 100 active jobs and full data-testid coverage (view-positions-btn, check-status-btn, filters, job-<id>, view-details-<id>, apply-now-<id>). Apply modal renders complete form (apply-name, apply-email, apply-phone, apply-source, upload-resume, upload-aadhaar/pan/marksheet, education-section + add/remove, work-history-section, submit-application). Candidate portal /candidate/<id> renders 5-step timeline (Applied/Assessment/Interview/Offer/Joined) with portal-current-status, portal-referral-card, portal-share-toggle, portal-timeline, portal-history testids and proper error boundary on invalid IDs (Cannot load your portal). Employee login /employee/login renders (employee-id-input, employee-password-input, employee-login-submit). Admin UI at /login remains blocked in preview by device-binding 403 (pre-existing infra) — admin flows verified via API + pytest instead. Applied a stale-assertion fix in test_careers_investors.py: application_id prefix changed from legacy APP- to PR-HR-YYYY-##### (matches current backend). No functional regressions found.
action_items: Admin Careers UI (/admin) could not be exercised via UI because /login returns 403 (device-binding) in this preview container. This is a pre-existing environment restriction, not a bug in the Careers/HR modules. To do a browser E2E of PayrollTab/OrgChartTab/PortalTab/JobsTab/ApplicationsTab/KanbanTab/TestsTab/EmployeesTab/AttendanceTab/LeavesTab/SystemTab/ReportsTab, either whitelist the preview device fingerprint or expose an admin bypass token. All admin business logic is already covered end-to-end by pytest against the real API.
critical_code_review_comments: Application ID format now standardises to PR-HR-YYYY-##### (via utils/id_counters.next_application_id). Confirmed consistent with PR-JOB-YYYY-#### for jobs and PR-EMP-##### for employees.
All new payroll, orgchart, and employee-portal endpoints properly namespaced under /api/public/{payroll,orgchart,employee,hr}. Consistent routing conventions.
Employee lockout returns HTTP 423 after 5 wrong logins as per playbook. bcrypt usage correct on employees collection.
Candidate portal endpoint properly redacts assessment correct_index and only exposes meet_link when interview status is scheduled — confirmed via test_candidate_portal.py.

rca of the issue: The only pytest failure encountered (test_apply_for_job_with_resume) was a stale assertion that expected application_id to start with 'APP-' whereas the backend now uses PR-HR-YYYY-##### (a deliberate schema change to unify with PR-JOB / PR-EMP). Updated the assertion; test now passes. No production bug — a test-file bug.
